description: The measures of the phase-1 path (MEDIR 1, P6 F1): what scripts/medir reads and how it summarizes it.

medir.landing_slack_s.description: P5 F3's second criterion: the shadow's ready to landed p50 at most the box's merge through Origin (p50) plus this, the forge's number plus our ~0.2 s (ARQUITETURA-ALVO §7).

medir.log_page.description: Events one read of the tenant's log answers while scripts/medir pages through it.

medir.prewarm_runner_usd_h.description: IMAGE-PREWARM-C: the hourly price of a runner standby (Fargate Spot ARM, 2 vCPU and 8 GB: about US$ 0.0101 per vCPU-hour and US$ 0.0011 per GB-hour, roughly 30% of the on-demand US$ 0.093/h, docs/operations/aws.md 22.9 item 6). scripts/medir prices each standby's started_at to stopped seconds with it as prewarm_task_usd. Data, not a bill: Spot prices move; correct it here.

medir.prewarm_service_usd_h.description: IMAGE-PREWARM-C: the hourly price of a service standby (Fargate Spot ARM, 0.25 vCPU and 0.5 GB: about US$ 0.0101 per vCPU-hour and US$ 0.0011 per GB-hour; on demand it is about US$ 0.01/h, docs/operations/aws.md 22.9 item 6). scripts/medir prices each standby's started_at to stopped seconds with it as prewarm_task_usd. Data, not a bill: Spot prices move; correct it here.

medir.quantiles.description: The quantiles scripts/medir answers for each measure (nearest rank): the p50 and p99 the plan asks for.

medir.shadow_prs.description: P5 F3's criterion: the PRs whose every head the box and the shadow judged the same, before delivery.judge turns to infra (PLANO-DE-IMPLEMENTACAO §6).

medir.webhook_ack_limit_s.description: The failure limit of a webhook ACK (PORT4, Daniel 08/11): the seconds the ingress may take to answer Origin's webhook, a cold start included. It is an acceptance criterion, not a timeout setting: it cuts nothing, and the 10 s Origin gives is not changed. Any single delivery over it is a failure (over_limit in the ingress log line, listed by scripts/medir), never a percentile. The stack hands it to the ingress as TOWER_INGRESS_ACK_LIMIT_S.
